kural:942.label: L
kural:942.meaning: One who eats only after prior food is digested needs no medicine.

kural:943.label: L
kural:943.science_concept: eating according to digestive capacity sustains life
kural:943.meaning: Eat recognizing digestion to prolong bodily health and life.

kural:944.label: L
kural:944.meaning: Understand digestion, eat proper food with true hunger.

kural:945.label: L
kural:945.science_concept: moderate and measured eating prevents disease
kural:945.meaning: Eating compatible food with moderation prevents bodily harm.

kural:946.label: L
kural:946.science_concept: dietary moderation brings health while gluttony brings disease
kural:946.meaning: Moderate eaters enjoy health, while gluttons suffer disease.

kural:948.label: L
kural:948.science_concept: medical diagnosis of disease and its root cause
kural:948.meaning: Examine the disease, its origin, and apply the correct cure.

kural:951.label: N
kural:951.meaning: Noble birth naturally possesses integrity and modesty.

kural:952.label: N
kural:952.meaning: The noble-born never fail in conduct, truth, and modesty.

kural:953.label: N
kural:953.meaning: Smile, charity, sweet words, and respect characterize true nobility.

kural:954.label: N
kural:954.meaning: Noble-born persons will not commit base acts even for wealth.

kural:955.label: N
kural:955.meaning: Ancient noble families retain their good character even in poverty.

kural:956.label: N
kural:956.meaning: Those who guard family prestige do not stoop to cunning acts.

kural:958.label: N
kural:958.meaning: If good people show lack of love, their lineage is doubted.

kural:959.label: O
kural:959.meaning: Sprouts show the soil's nature; words show the worth of birth.

kural:960.label: N
kural:960.meaning: Modesty brings goodness; humility preserves noble lineage.

kural:961.label: N
kural:961.meaning: Even vital gains should be abandoned if achieved through degradation.

kural:962.label: N
kural:962.meaning: Those seeking honour and fame will not commit mean deeds.

kural:963.label: N
kural:963.meaning: Be humble in prosperity, and maintain dignity in adversity.

kural:965.label: N
kural:965.meaning: Even great men fall due to small misdeeds.

kural:967.label: N
kural:967.meaning: Better to die than live subservient to enemies.

kural:968.label: N
kural:968.meaning: Nurturing the body is worthless when honour is lost.

kural:972.label: N
kural:972.meaning: All humans are equal by birth, differing only in actions.

kural:973.label: N
kural:973.meaning: The ignoble high are not truly high; the noble low are not low.

kural:974.label: N
kural:974.meaning: Greatness like chastity is sustained through self-discipline and proper conduct.

kural:975.label: N
kural:975.meaning: Great souls accomplish difficult and rare deeds through determined effort.

kural:976.label: N
kural:976.meaning: The small-minded lack the discernment to cherish and seek great people.

kural:977.label: N
kural:977.meaning: Power and privilege make base people act with insolence and harm.

kural:978.label: N
kural:978.meaning: Truly great people are humble, whereas petty individuals boast with vanity.

kural:979.label: N
kural:979.meaning: True greatness avoids arrogance, while littleness is driven by pride.

kural:980.label: N
kural:980.meaning: Greatness conceals the faults of others, while smallness exposes them.

kural:981.label: N
kural:981.meaning: All virtuous actions are a duty for those who uphold nobility.

kural:982.label: N
kural:982.meaning: Good character is the true excellence of the noble; other traits do not matter.

kural:983.label: N
kural:983.meaning: Love, modesty, equity, grace, and truth form the pillars of nobility.

kural:984.label: N
kural:984.meaning: Non-violence is the essence of asceticism, and refraining from slander is nobility.

kural:985.label: N
kural:985.meaning: Humility is the strength of the wise and a weapon that converts enemies.

kural:986.label: N
kural:986.meaning: Accepting defeat even from inferiors is the test of noble character.

kural:987.label: N
kural:987.meaning: What is the worth of perfection if it does not return good for evil?

kural:988.label: N
kural:988.meaning: Poverty is no disgrace to one who possesses the strength of good character.

kural:991.label: N
kural:991.meaning: Courtesy and friendliness are easily attained by those who are accessible.

kural:992.label: N
kural:992.meaning: Possessing love and noble birth fosters the practice of courtesy.

kural:993.label: N
kural:993.meaning: True likeness is of character, not mere physical resemblance.

kural:994.label: N
kural:994.meaning: The world praises the character of helpful and righteous people.

kural:995.label: N
kural:995.meaning: The wise do not show contempt even in jest, even towards enemies.

kural:997.label: N
kural:997.meaning: Those lacking human character are like wooden blocks, despite sharp intellect.

kural:998.label: N
kural:998.meaning: Failing to show courtesy even to unfriendly people is a grave fault.

kural:1000.label: O
kural:1000.science_concept: milk spoils when kept in an unclean vessel
kural:1000.meaning: The wealth of a churlish man is like milk spoiled by an impure vessel.

kural:1001.label: N
kural:1001.meaning: A miser hoarding wealth without enjoying it is considered as good as dead.

kural:1002.label: N
kural:1002.meaning: A miser's hoard leads only to a ruined birth.

kural:1004.label: N
kural:1004.meaning: An unloved person leaves no lasting legacy.

kural:1005.label: N
kural:1005.meaning: Hoarding wealth without giving or enjoying is useless.

kural:1006.label: N
kural:1006.meaning: Great wealth is useless if not enjoyed or given to the worthy.

kural:1007.label: N
kural:1007.meaning: Wealth that helps no one is like a lonely beauty aging unwed.

kural:1008.label: O
kural:1008.science_concept: poisonous fruit tree in a village
kural:1008.meaning: The wealth of an ungenerous man is like a poison-fruit tree in a town.

kural:1009.label: N
kural:1009.meaning: Wealth gathered without love or virtue will be seized by others.

kural:1011.label: N
kural:1011.meaning: True shame is shrinking from evil deeds.

kural:1012.label: N
kural:1012.meaning: Basic needs are common to all; modesty distinguishes noble people.

kural:1013.label: N
kural:1013.meaning: All physical life depends on the body, just as nobility depends on modesty.

kural:1014.label: N
kural:1014.meaning: Modesty is the true ornament of the wise.

kural:1015.label: N
kural:1015.meaning: Those who feel shame for faults are the abode of modesty.

kural:1017.label: N
kural:1017.meaning: People of shame give up life for shame; they do not give up shame for life.

kural:1018.label: N
kural:1018.meaning: If one is not ashamed of what others are ashamed of, it brings shame to virtue.

kural:1019.label: N
kural:1019.meaning: Bad conduct ruins family lineage, and lack of shame destroys all good traits.

kural:1020.label: O
kural:1020.meaning: The movement of the shameless is like a wooden puppet made to dance by strings.

kural:1021.label: N
kural:1021.meaning: There is no greater glory than a person saying 'I will not fail in my task.'

kural:1022.label: N
kural:1022.meaning: A family prospers through persistent effort and profound wisdom combined.

kural:1023.label: N
kural:1023.meaning: For one who resolves to uplift his family, divinity itself steps forward to assist.

kural:1024.label: N
kural:1024.meaning: Success comes effortlessly to those who tirelessly work to lift their lineage.

kural:1025.label: N
kural:1025.meaning: The world surrounds and claims as kin the faultless person who supports his family.

kural:1026.label: N
kural:1026.meaning: True manliness is making one's native household prosperous and strong.

kural:1027.label: N
kural:1027.meaning: Like brave heroes in battle, the burden of the household rests on the capable.

kural:1029.label: N
kural:1029.meaning: Is not the body a vessel of sorrows for one who protects his family from ruin?

pavai:1.label: M
pavai:1.meaning: Devotional praise describing Krishna's complexion like a dark cloud, sun, and moon.

pavai:2.label: N
pavai:2.meaning: Rules of observance, fasting, and charity during Margazhi.

pavai:3.label: O
pavai:3.science_concept: seasonal rain, crop growth, and water life
pavai:3.meaning: Abundant rain makes paddy grow, fish leap, and bees sleep in lotus flowers.

pavai:4.label: O
pavai:4.science_concept: rain clouds, lightning, thunder, and heavy downpour
pavai:4.meaning: Clouds gather water from the sea, flash like Vishnu's discus, thunder, and rain arrows.

pavai:5.label: M
pavai:5.meaning: Past sins burn to ash like cotton in fire through devotion.

pavai:6.label: O
pavai:6.science_concept: birds waking and sounding at dawn
pavai:6.meaning: Birds chirp at dawn while devotees chant the name of Vishnu.

pavai:7.label: O
pavai:7.science_concept: birds and churning sound at dawn
pavai:7.meaning: Birds chatter and cowherds churn curd, making sounds at dawn.

pavai:8.label: O
pavai:8.science_concept: eastern sky brightening and cattle grazing at dawn
pavai:8.meaning: The eastern sky whitens and buffaloes spread out to graze early.

pavai:9.label: N
pavai:9.meaning: Calling out to a sleeping cousin to wake up and chant Vishnu's names.

pavai:10.label: N
pavai:10.meaning: Teasing a sleeping girl comparing her deep slumber to that of Kumbhakarna.

pavai:11.label: N
pavai:11.meaning: Praising a cowherd girl and urging her to join in singing the Lord's praise.

pavai:12.label: O
pavai:12.science_concept: mother cows leaking milk for calves
pavai:12.meaning: Mugging calves make milk flow from cow's udders, dampening the muddy courtyard.

pavai:13.label: O
pavai:13.science_concept: Venus rising, Jupiter setting, birds chirping
pavai:13.meaning: Venus rises, Jupiter sets, and birds chirp at dawn.

pavai:14.label: O
pavai:14.science_concept: lotus blooms at sunrise, water lilies close
pavai:14.meaning: Water lilies open at sunrise and night-blooming lilies close.

pavai:15.label: N
pavai:15.meaning: Waking up a companion girl; no natural-science content.

pavai:16.label: N
pavai:16.meaning: Requesting the temple guardian to open the door; no natural-science content.

pavai:17.label: N
pavai:17.meaning: Praising figures of authority and Krishna; no natural-science content.

pavai:18.label: O
pavai:18.science_concept: roosters crowing at dawn, cuckoos singing
pavai:18.meaning: Roosters call and cuckoos sing in the morning.

pavai:19.label: N
pavai:19.meaning: Urging Nappinnai to let her husband wake; no natural-science content.

pavai:20.label: N
pavai:20.meaning: Praising gods and awakening Nappinnai; no natural-science content.

pavai:21.label: O
pavai:21.meaning: Generous cows overflow milking vessels with milk.

pavai:22.label: O
pavai:22.meaning: Eyes opening like the simultaneous rising of the sun and moon.

pavai:23.label: O
pavai:23.meaning: A lion wakes up in a mountain cave and roars.

pavai:24.label: N
pavai:24.meaning: Praising Vishnu's mythical exploits; no natural-science content.

pavai:25.label: M
pavai:25.meaning: Devotional verse about Krishna causing fear in Kamsa like fire in the belly.

pavai:26.label: M
pavai:26.meaning: Praising Vishnu, the banyan leaf entity, and asking for festival items.

pavai:27.label: N
pavai:27.meaning: Devotees ask Krishna for ornaments, garments, and a feast of rice with ghee.

pavai:28.label: N
pavai:28.meaning: Cowherd girls express eternal kinship and love for Govinda, asking for forgiveness.

pavai:29.label: N
pavai:29.meaning: Pledging servitude to Krishna across seven times seven births.

pavai:30.label: N
pavai:30.meaning: Concluding verse on the benefits of chanting Andal's Tiruppavai.

kural:1030.label: N
kural:1030.meaning: A household without a capable helper collapses during hard times.

kural:1031.label: L
kural:1031.science_concept: agriculture is the foundational economic activity sustaining society
kural:1031.meaning: Though people pursue various trades, the world revolves around the plow; farming is supreme.

kural:1032.label: L
kural:1032.science_concept: farmers are the linchpin supporting all other professions
kural:1032.meaning: Farmers are the linchpin of mankind, supporting all other workers who cannot till.

kural:1033.label: L
kural:1033.science_concept: self-sufficient agricultural labor is true independent living
kural:1033.meaning: Only those who live by farming truly live; all others follow and eat by bowing to others.

kural:1034.label: N
kural:1034.meaning: Those who possess abundant crops will see monarchs of many umbrellas seek their shade.

kural:1035.label: N
kural:1035.meaning: Those who labor with their hands do not beg, but share their food with others.

kural:1036.label: L
kural:1036.science_concept: agriculture sustains human life and monks
kural:1036.meaning: If ploughmen fold their hands, even those who renounce desire face starvation.

kural:1038.label: L
kural:1038.science_concept: manuring, weeding and crop protection in agriculture
kural:1038.meaning: Manuring is better than ploughing, weeding is better than watering, and protection is vital.

kural:1041.label: N
kural:1041.meaning: Nothing causes more misery and pain than poverty itself.

kural:1043.label: N
kural:1043.meaning: Poverty destroys noble ancestry and the dignity of speech.

kural:1044.label: N
kural:1044.meaning: Poverty causes even born gentlemen to utter demeaning words.

kural:1045.label: N
kural:1045.meaning: The affliction of poverty brings numerous other sorrows along with it.

kural:1047.label: N
kural:1047.meaning: A mother treats her own poverty-stricken son as if he were a stranger.

kural:1051.label: N
kural:1051.meaning: Beg from those who can give; if they refuse, the fault is theirs.

kural:1052.label: N
kural:1052.meaning: Begging can be a joy if the requested item comes without humiliation.

kural:1053.label: N
kural:1053.meaning: It is graceful to ask from open-hearted people who understand their duty.

kural:1054.label: N
kural:1054.meaning: Begging from the generous is like giving, for they do not hide their wealth.

kural:1056.label: N
kural:1056.meaning: The pain of poverty vanishes when one meets generous people who do not hoard.

kural:1057.label: N
kural:1057.meaning: Seeing generous givers without scorn brings joy to the inner heart.

kural:1059.label: N
kural:1059.meaning: What is the glory of givers when there are no beggars around.

kural:1060.label: N
kural:1060.meaning: The needy should not show anger at refusal, as their own poverty is proof enough.

kural:1061.label: N
kural:1061.meaning: Not to beg is worth a billion, even from dear friends who give with joy.

kural:1062.label: N
kural:1062.meaning: If one must live by begging, let the Creator of the world perish.

kural:1063.label: N
kural:1063.meaning: Nothing is as harsh as saying one will cure poverty by begging.

kural:1067.label: N
kural:1067.meaning: If I must beg of beggars, I beg them not to beg from misers.

kural:1068.label: O
kural:1068.meaning: The fragile boat of beggary shatters when it strikes the rock of refusal.

kural:1070.label: N
kural:1070.meaning: Where will misers hide when the beggar's sharp words cause their life to depart?

kural:1071.label: N
kural:1071.meaning: Base persons resemble humans only in form, having no true likeness.

kural:1072.label: N
kural:1072.meaning: The base appear richer than the wise because they are free from mental anxiety.

kural:1073.label: N
kural:1073.meaning: The base are like gods because they too act entirely as their desires prompt.

kural:1074.label: N
kural:1074.meaning: Base people rejoice and feel superior when they see someone ruined.

kural:1075.label: N
kural:1075.meaning: Fear governs the conduct of the base, and some craving may still remain.

kural:1077.label: N
kural:1077.meaning: The base will not give anything unless forced by violence to their jaws.

kural:1078.label: N
kural:1078.meaning: The wise are moved by gentle words, while the base yield only when crushed like sugarcane.

kural:1079.label: N
kural:1079.meaning: The mean look for faults in others upon seeing what they eat and wear.

kural:1080.label: N
kural:1080.meaning: The base are ready to sell themselves quickly when trouble strikes.

kural:1081.label: O
kural:1081.meaning: Is she a goddess, a peacock, or a jewelled woman that bewilders my mind?

kural:1082.label: N
kural:1082.meaning: The mutual glance of the woman is like an armed attack of a love-goddess.

kural:1083.label: N
kural:1083.meaning: I did not know death before, but now I know it in the form of a woman with battling eyes.

kural:1084.label: N
kural:1084.meaning: The innocent woman's darting eyes consume the lives of those who look at her.

kural:1087.label: O
kural:1087.meaning: The garment on the woman's breast resembles the eye-cover of a rutting elephant.

kural:1088.label: N
kural:1088.meaning: My pride, feared by enemies in battle, is broken by her bright forehead.

kural:1089.label: N
kural:1089.meaning: A beautiful and modest woman needs no added ornaments.

kural:1090.label: N
kural:1090.meaning: Wine intoxicates only when drunk, but the sight of love intoxicates on contact.

kural:1091.label: N
kural:1091.meaning: Her painted eyes have two glances: one causes pain, the other cures it.

kural:1092.label: N
kural:1092.meaning: A furtive glance is greater than half the joy of love.

kural:1095.label: N
kural:1095.meaning: She avoids a direct look, casting a side-long glance with a smile.

kural:1096.label: N
kural:1096.meaning: Words that seem distant are quickly understood as friendly.

kural:1097.label: N
kural:1097.meaning: Harsh words and angry looks from loved ones are actually signs of affection.

kural:1098.label: N
kural:1098.meaning: What grace the slender maid possesses as she smiles gently at my gaze.

kural:1099.label: N
kural:1099.meaning: Lovers sometimes exchange glances as though they were complete strangers.

kural:1100.label: N
kural:1100.meaning: Spoken words are useless when the eyes meet in complete accord.

kural:1102.label: N
kural:1102.meaning: Illnesses have external cures, but the fair maid is her own cure for love-sickness.

kural:1105.label: N
kural:1105.meaning: The embrace of the flower-tressed maid adapts to whatever desire I hold.

kural:1107.label: N
kural:1107.meaning: The embrace of a beloved is like sharing one's meal.

kural:1108.label: O
kural:1108.science_concept: air cannot pass through a tight embrace
kural:1108.meaning: A tight embrace that allows no air to pass between lovers.

kural:1109.label: N
kural:1109.meaning: Sulking, reconciliation, and union are the joys of love.

kural:1110.label: N
kural:1110.meaning: Love grows deeper and more mysterious the closer one gets.

kural:1111.label: O
kural:1111.science_concept: softness of anicha flower compared to human skin
kural:1111.meaning: The beloved is softer than the delicate anicha flower.

kural:1112.label: N
kural:1112.meaning: Common flowers cannot compare to the beauty of her eyes.

kural:1113.label: N
kural:1113.meaning: Descriptions of the beloved's body parts and pleasant attributes.

kural:1114.label: O
kural:1114.science_concept: water lily drooping towards the ground
kural:1114.meaning: The water lily droops, admitting defeat to her beautiful eyes.

kural:1115.label: O
kural:1115.science_concept: heavy weight of anicha flower with its stem on the body
kural:1115.meaning: Even the delicate anicha flower with its stem is too heavy for her.

kural:1120.label: O
kural:1120.science_concept: softness of anicha flower and swan feathers
kural:1120.meaning: Soft flowers and swan down feel like sharp thorns to her feet.

kural:1122.label: N
kural:1122.meaning: The bond between lovers is like the union of soul and body.

kural:1123.label: O
kural:1123.science_concept: reflection in the pupil of the eye
kural:1123.meaning: Asking the image in the pupil to step aside for the beloved.

kural:1124.label: N
kural:1124.meaning: Union with the beloved is life, and separation is death.

kural:1125.label: N
kural:1125.meaning: The lover constantly remembers the virtues of his beloved.

kural:1126.label: N
kural:1126.meaning: The subtle lover remains in the eye without leaving.

kural:1127.label: N
kural:1127.meaning: The lover is in the eyes, so makeup is avoided.

kural:1129.label: N
kural:1129.meaning: Avoiding winking to keep the lover hidden, though the town misinterprets.

kural:1130.label: N
kural:1130.meaning: The lover stays in the heart, but outsiders think otherwise.

kural:1131.label: N
kural:1131.meaning: Riding the palmyra horse is the only remedy for love's pangs.

kural:1132.label: N
kural:1132.meaning: Discarding shame, pining body and mind resort to riding the palmyra stem.

kural:1136.label: N
kural:1136.meaning: Thinking of riding the palmyra horse at midnight while eyes stay sleepless.

kural:1138.label: N
kural:1138.meaning: Uncontrollable love breaks through modesty and exposes itself publicly.

kural:1139.label: N
kural:1139.meaning: Secret love wanders bewildered in public streets, falsely thinking nobody knows.

kural:1140.label: N
kural:1140.meaning: Ignorant people laugh openly because they do not feel the lover's suffering.

kural:1141.label: N
kural:1141.meaning: Rumor sustains the speaker's life, a secret luck unknown to many.

kural:1142.label: N
kural:1142.meaning: The town gives the speaker rumor instead of appreciating the flower-eyed lady.

kural:1143.label: N
kural:1143.meaning: Public rumor feels like acquiring something without actually possessing it.

kural:1144.label: N
kural:1144.meaning: Rumor intensifies love, which would otherwise lose its distinctive edge.

kural:1145.label: N
kural:1145.meaning: Just as drinking liquor pleases, love becomes sweeter as it becomes public.

kural:1149.label: N
kural:1149.meaning: Why feel shame over rumor when the lover who promised no fear has abandoned her?

kural:1150.label: N
kural:1150.meaning: The lover is willing to grant love, while the town raises this noisy rumor.

kural:1151.label: N
kural:1151.meaning: Tell me if you are not leaving; speak of your quick return to those who stay alive.

kural:1152.label: N
kural:1152.meaning: His glance brought joy, but union brings pain due to the constant fear of parting.

kural:1153.label: N
kural:1153.meaning: Trust is difficult even with the wise because the possibility of parting exists.

kural:1154.label: N
kural:1154.meaning: Is it a fault to trust the reassuring words of one who now departs?

kural:1155.label: N
kural:1155.meaning: Prevent the trusted companion from leaving, as reunion is difficult once parted.

kural:1156.label: N
kural:1156.meaning: Parting words and the lingering hope of renewed love.

kural:1158.label: N
kural:1158.meaning: Living in a friendless place is hard, but parting from loved ones is worse.

kural:1162.label: N
kural:1162.meaning: Cannot conceal the pain of love nor confess it without shame.

kural:1163.label: N
kural:1163.meaning: Lust and shame are balanced inside this weary body.

kural:1165.label: N
kural:1165.meaning: What will those do as foes who cause woe while in friendship?

kural:1171.label: N
kural:1171.meaning: Why do the eyes weep now, having brought this endless pain?

kural:1174.label: N
kural:1174.meaning: Eyes left dry without relief, causing incurable pain.

kural:1176.label: N
kural:1176.meaning: The eyes that caused this love-sickness are now victims of it.

kural:1178.label: N
kural:1178.meaning: My eyes still pine to see him even though his heart is indifferent.

kural:1179.label: N
kural:1179.meaning: No sleep whether he comes or goes; the fate of weeping eyes.

kural:1180.label: N
kural:1180.meaning: Eyes reveal secrets like a beating drum.

kural:1181.label: N
kural:1181.meaning: To whom can I explain my pale complexion caused by my lover's absence?

kural:1182.label: N
kural:1182.meaning: Pallor appears on the body due to longing for the lover.

kural:1183.label: N
kural:1183.meaning: The lover took away beauty and modesty, leaving illness and pallor.

kural:1184.label: N
kural:1184.meaning: Thoughts of the lover cause pallor to spread over the body.

kural:1185.label: N
kural:1185.meaning: As the lover departs there, pallor takes over the body here.

kural:1187.label: N
kural:1187.meaning: Pallor engulfs the body the moment the embrace is broken.

kural:1188.label: N
kural:1188.meaning: People blame her pallor without acknowledging the lover who abandoned her.

kural:1189.label: N
kural:1189.meaning: Let the body turn pale if the lover who caused it fares well.

kural:1190.label: N
kural:1190.meaning: It is good to be called pale if it protects the lover from blame.

kural:1191.label: N
kural:1191.meaning: Mutual love is like a stoneless fruit of desire.

kural:1193.label: N
kural:1193.meaning: The pride of life belongs to those whose love is reciprocated.

kural:1194.label: N
kural:1194.meaning: Unrequited lovers lack companionship and fortune.

kural:1195.label: N
kural:1195.meaning: What can a lover do if they do not share the same affection?

kural:1196.label: O
kural:1196.meaning: Unrequited love causes pain, while mutual love balances and pleases like shoulder-poles.

kural:1197.label: N
kural:1197.meaning: Lamenting over the unilateral pain inflicted by the god of love.

kural:1199.label: N
kural:1199.meaning: The lover's words remain sweet to the ear even when neglected.

kural:1202.label: N
kural:1202.meaning: Love is sweet because thinking of the beloved brings joy.

kural:1203.label: O
kural:1203.science_concept: sneeze reflex as a sign of being remembered
kural:1203.meaning: A suppressed sneeze feels like an unfulfilled thought from the beloved.

kural:1204.label: N
kural:1204.meaning: Wondering if the beloved's heart holds the speaker as the speaker's heart holds them.

kural:1205.label: N
kural:1205.meaning: Complaining that the beloved enters the speaker's heart while barring entry to theirs.

kural:1206.label: N
kural:1206.meaning: The speaker only exists through the memory of days spent with the beloved.

kural:1207.label: N
kural:1207.meaning: Even remembering the beloved burns the heart, making forgetting impossible.

kural:1208.label: N
kural:1208.meaning: The beloved never gets angry despite constant remembrance.

kural:1209.label: N
kural:1209.meaning: Life fades thinking of the cruelty of one who claimed they were inseparable.

kural:1211.label: N
kural:1211.meaning: How to reward the dream that brings the message of the beloved.

kural:1212.label: N
kural:1212.meaning: Eyes compared to fish expressing grief of separation; no science content.

kural:1213.label: N
kural:1213.meaning: Sustaining life through dreams of the beloved; no natural-science content.

kural:1214.label: N
kural:1214.meaning: Desire generated by dreams when waking love is absent; emotional theme.

kural:1215.label: N
kural:1215.meaning: Comparing the joy of seeing the beloved in dream and awake.

kural:1216.label: N
kural:1216.meaning: Wish for the absence of waking reality so dreams of the lover persist.

kural:1217.label: N
kural:1217.meaning: Complaining about the cruel lover appearing in dreams while ignoring her awake.

kural:1218.label: N
kural:1218.meaning: Embracing in sleep and dwelling in the heart when awake; love poetry.

kural:1219.label: N
kural:1219.meaning: Those who do not see their lovers in dreams lament their waking absence.

kural:1220.label: N
kural:1220.meaning: Townspeople misjudging the lover's departure based on dream states.

kural:1222.label: M
kural:1222.meaning: Addressing the evening as having a cruel companion; personification.

kural:1224.label: M
kural:1224.meaning: Evening arrives like an executioner when the lover is absent; metaphor.

kural:1225.label: N
kural:1225.meaning: Contrasting the pleasant morning with the painful evening; emotional state.

kural:1226.label: N
kural:1226.meaning: Evening pangs were unknown to me when my lord did not leave me.

kural:1231.label: N
kural:1231.meaning: Thinking of him who left to banish poverty, my eyes put flowers to shame.

kural:1232.label: N
kural:1232.meaning: Pale and tearful eyes reveal the unkind absence of my lover.

kural:1234.label: N
kural:1234.meaning: Bracelets slip off and shoulders lose their beauty due to his separation.

kural:1235.label: N
kural:1235.meaning: Faded arms and loose bracelets proclaim the cruelty of my absent lord.

kural:1236.label: N
kural:1236.meaning: My thinning arms grieve when you call my husband cruel.

kural:1237.label: N
kural:1237.meaning: O heart, go and tell the cruel one of the distress of my wasted arms.

kural:1240.label: N
kural:1240.meaning: My eyes grew pale seeing the pallor on the bright forehead of this lady.

kural:1242.label: N
kural:1242.meaning: O my heart, it is foolish to pine for one who has no love for us.

kural:1243.label: N
kural:1243.meaning: O heart, why grieve and pine? Those who caused this pain have no pity.

kural:1244.label: N
kural:1244.meaning: O heart, take these eyes with you to see him, or they will consume me.

kural:1245.label: N
kural:1245.meaning: O heart, even if he spurns us, can we ever abandon him as a foe?

kural:1247.label: N
kural:1247.meaning: Internal conflict between love and shame.

kural:1249.label: N
kural:1249.meaning: The lover residing in the mind and thoughts.

kural:1250.label: N
kural:1250.meaning: Suffering and loss of beauty due to desertion.

kural:1251.label: N
kural:1251.meaning: Passion breaking down the barriers of reserve.

kural:1252.label: N
kural:1252.meaning: The relentless power of lust controlling the heart at midnight.

kural:1253.label: O
kural:1253.meaning: Desire reveals itself involuntarily just like a sudden sneeze.

kural:1254.label: N
kural:1254.meaning: Desire betraying personal reserve and restraint.

kural:1255.label: N
kural:1255.meaning: Dignity fails those who are afflicted by love-sickness.

kural:1256.label: N
kural:1256.meaning: The peculiar grief and caprice of being lovesick.

kural:1257.label: N
kural:1257.meaning: Shame is forgotten when fulfilling the desires of a lover.

kural:1258.label: N
kural:1258.meaning: The deceptive and tempting words of a cunning lover.

kural:1261.label: N
kural:1261.meaning: Dim eyes and worn fingers counting the days of separation.

kural:1263.label: N
kural:1263.meaning: A wife lives in hope of her husband's return.

kural:1264.label: N
kural:1264.meaning: The heart beats with joy anticipating the return of the lover.

kural:1265.label: N
kural:1265.meaning: Sallowness of shoulders will vanish when I see my husband.

kural:1267.label: N
kural:1267.meaning: Pondering whether to sulk, embrace, or welcome the beloved.

kural:1270.label: N
kural:1270.meaning: Acquisitions and embraces matter little when the heart is broken.

kural:1271.label: N
kural:1271.meaning: The expressive eyes betray the emotions despite attempts to hide.

kural:1272.label: O
kural:1272.meaning: The simple maiden has bamboo-like arms and admirable qualities.

kural:1273.label: O
kural:1273.meaning: Something shines through her ornaments like thread through a gem.

kural:1274.label: O
kural:1274.science_concept: fragrance residing within a flower bud
kural:1274.meaning: A subtle meaning is concealed in her smile like fragrance in a bud.

kural:1276.label: N
kural:1276.meaning: Deep embraces bring comfort but also hint at eventual parting.

kural:1277.label: N
kural:1277.meaning: Bracelets loosen, sensing the impending separation from the lord.

kural:1279.label: N
kural:1279.meaning: She checks her bracelets, arms, and feet in pensive shyness.

kural:1281.label: N
kural:1281.meaning: The ecstasy of thought and joy of sight belong to love rather than wine.

kural:1282.label: N
kural:1282.meaning: Sulking should be minimal when passion grows immense like a palmyra tree.

kural:1283.label: N
kural:1283.meaning: Though the lord slights her, her restless eyes still long to see him.

kural:1284.label: N
kural:1284.meaning: She intended to sulk, but her heart forgot and rushed to embrace him.

kural:1285.label: O
kural:1285.science_concept: eye unable to see the pencil applying collyrium
kural:1285.meaning: When seeing her lord she sees no flaws, like eyes that see not the painter's brush.

kural:1286.label: N
kural:1286.meaning: When he is present she sees no faults, and when absent she sees nothing else.

kural:1287.label: O
kural:1287.science_concept: jumping into a rushing flood knowing the danger
kural:1287.meaning: Feign a huff with the lord just like diving into a rushing stream knowing it carries one away.

kural:1288.label: N
kural:1288.meaning: Like intoxicating wine, the lover's breast is sweet despite humiliation.

kural:1291.label: N
kural:1291.meaning: His heart belongs to him, but why does my heart refuse to obey me?

kural:1292.label: N
kural:1292.meaning: Though he slights her, her heart still seeks him out as a friend.

kural:1293.label: N
kural:1293.meaning: You follow him blindly; is it because the fallen have no friends?

kural:1294.label: N
kural:1294.meaning: Since you will not sulk and then enjoy union, who will consult you, my heart?

kural:1295.label: N
kural:1295.meaning: The heart suffers ceaseless pain fearing loss and separation in love.

kural:1296.label: N
kural:1296.meaning: My mind consumes me as I muse on him alone.

kural:1297.label: N
kural:1297.meaning: I forget shame but cannot forget him, caught in my foolish mind.

kural:1298.label: N
kural:1298.meaning: My heart loves him and cherishes his glory, ignoring any shame.

kural:1299.label: N
kural:1299.meaning: Who can support someone in grief if their own heart does not help?

kural:1300.label: N
kural:1300.meaning: Why expect strangers to be loyal when one's own heart is not?

kural:1301.label: N
kural:1301.meaning: Do not embrace him immediately so we can see his distress.

kural:1303.label: N
kural:1303.meaning: Refusing to embrace a pouting lover causes them unnecessary grief.

kural:1304.label: O
kural:1304.science_concept: cutting the root of a wilting plant
kural:1304.meaning: Failing to comfort a pouting lover is like cutting the root of a wilting plant.

kural:1305.label: N
kural:1305.meaning: The pout of flower-eyed women adds a lovely grace to good partners.

kural:1306.label: O
kural:1306.meaning: Love without lovers' quarrels is like missing both ripe and raw fruits.

kural:1307.label: N
kural:1307.meaning: The doubt of when union will happen brings pain during lovers' pouts.

kural:1308.label: N
kural:1308.meaning: Grieving in the absence of a caring lover who understands pain.

kural:1310.label: N
kural:1310.meaning: The heart still desires union with the one who caused sulking.

kural:1311.label: N
kural:1311.meaning: Refusing a lover's embrace because he is common to many women.

kural:1314.label: N
kural:1314.meaning: A lover becomes jealous and sulks when told she is loved most.

kural:1315.label: N
kural:1315.meaning: Eyes fill with tears at the mere mention of possible separation.

kural:1318.label: N
kural:1318.meaning: Suppressed sneeze makes her weep, suspecting hidden thoughts.

kural:1319.label: N
kural:1319.meaning: She is angry even when coaxed, suspecting similar behavior with others.

kural:1320.label: N
kural:1320.meaning: She scolds when gazed at thoughtfully, suspecting thoughts of another.

kural:1321.label: N
kural:1321.meaning: Feigning sulking even without fault to test a lover's affection.

kural:1322.label: N
kural:1322.meaning: Petty pouting enhances the value of subsequent affectionate reconciliation.

kural:1324.label: N
kural:1324.meaning: A weapon of resistance appears within sustained pouting after an embrace.

kural:1325.label: N
kural:1325.meaning: There is a special charm in releasing oneself from a beloved's faultless arms.

kural:1326.label: L
kural:1326.science_concept: food digestion is beneficial for health
kural:1326.meaning: Digestion of food is sweeter than eating itself.

kural:1328.label: O
kural:1328.science_concept: perspiration on forehead from physical exertion/warmth
kural:1328.meaning: Dew-like sweat on the brow during loving union.

kural:1330.label: N
kural:1330.meaning: Lovers' quarrels and subsequent union bring delight; no natural-science content.
